PlugInPackageMetaData.Author: Hamied Nabizada
PlugInPackageMetaData.Description: AutomationML Editor plugin that exports trees, attribute panels, the window or any region as vector graphics (SVG, PDF, PNG) for papers and slides. Shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+E complete tree, Ctrl+Shift+K tree to clipboard, Ctrl+Shift+W whole window, Ctrl+Shift+R drag a region. Options in the SvgExport panel.
